name: distribution_repair
scope: Rerun all 1839 original events, preserving every field of the 1359 previously supported events. Inspect all 211 previously unsupported gross-amount events; no account, holding, forecast or return selects acceptance. The diagnostic inventory is not financial verification.
selection_requirements: Candidate selection, formal implementation title, issuer, receipt, document hash and catalogue-plus-next-day availability rules remain unchanged.

Require a unique explicitly gross current amount, original record/ex dates, unchanged exact structured-source agreement and the existing Decimal tolerance; accept availability dates only. Preserve manual economic corrections.
Keep every original record, candidate, exclusion and prior supported field. Contradictions fail acceptance and remain recorded; do not tune thresholds to retain counts.
validation: Freeze the before extractor. Tests must demonstrate the actual missed currency-definition, heading and dividend-wording cases, including negative tax-net, H-share, historical, proposal, arbitrary-parenthetical and wrong-section cases.

Run the production review on all 1839 identities. Independently read every newly accepted date and supporting gross/record/ex field from full primary PDFs using PyMuPDF and original structured raw rows, without calling production extraction. Verify issuer, title and all source hashes.

Inventory archived amendments for newly supported issuers and compare related periods and any revised terms. An unresolved amendment blocks acceptance. Render complete relevant pages for each added wording/layout family and every mismatch, plus the remaining inner-event source.

Preserve all 35106 baseline frozen files and all runtime modules except distributions.py and the semantic package version. AST-check that only registered lexical constants in _current_scheme and extract_terms change; every financial/date/provider/selection gate stays exact.

Run Ruff/full pytest, ordinary active-model reloads with identity guards, frozen-input and frozen-plan binding checks, full physical integrity, actual CI and changed remote bytes. No training, historical account changes or forward observations are claimed in this source-only phase.
integration_gate: Source facts only. A separate registered integration must validate active event identity, unchanged prior terms and label scope, rebuild, fully refit and compare fixed forecasts/full accounts/paper checks before changing inputs or flags.
risk: Balanced attack, 8% warning, original high-water mark, latched/non-recovering risk, positive_score and legacy turnover remain unchanged. No alpha candidates or relaxed gates.
limitations: This reviews the frozen archive, not a certified complete history of every filing or amendment. Catalogue-plus-next-day remains a retrospective availability convention.
Companion-role resolution and verified dates do not certify all economic terms, taxes, fractional shares or complete event entitlements.
Current-universe bias, historical status/quote gaps, complete ETF exposure, competition execution details and future observations remain open.
wording_changes: Current implementation headings may say 权益分配 as well as 权益分派, and may contain an explicit 20xx年 annual/interim/quarter qualifier before the scheme name. Keep the current-section requirement and clause exclusions unchanged.
Per-ten gross cash can use 派送 or 分配现金 as well as 派/派发. Cash 股息 is a dividend noun alongside 红利/股利/分红. Do not recognize tax-net, reference-price, historical, H-share or unqualified proposal amounts.
Between 元人民币 and 现金, allow only the literal currency definition (以下简称“元”), including normalized straight quotation marks. Do not skip arbitrary parenthetical clauses or remove words from evidence.
Do not extend page-joining, deduplication, missing-tax-qualifier, arbitrary number-spacing, approved-proposal or date rules in this phase. Unsupported wording remains unresolved.
